description: Header file defining classes, structs, and functions related to uniform layout and packing in GLSL and HLSL, including block layout encoders for std140 and std430 standards, and visitor patterns for shader variables.

classes.name: BlockLayoutEncoder
classes.description: Abstract base class for encoding block layouts, providing interface for layout calculation and offset management.

classes.name: DummyBlockEncoder
classes.description: Dummy implementation of BlockLayoutEncoder that returns default values.

classes.name: Std140BlockEncoder
classes.description: Encoder implementing std140 uniform block layout rules.

classes.name: Std430BlockEncoder
classes.description: Encoder implementing std430 uniform block layout rules.

classes.name: ShaderVariableVisitor
classes.description: Abstract visitor class for traversing shader variables.

classes.name: VariableNameVisitor
classes.description: Concrete visitor for variable name processing, managing name stacks.

classes.name: BlockEncoderVisitor
classes.description: Visitor that encodes shader variables into block layout information.

methods.name: encodeType
methods.description: Encodes the type of a shader variable into block layout info.

methods.name: getCurrentOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset in the layout.

methods.name: getShaderVariableSize
methods.description: Calculates size of a shader variable based on layout rules.

methods.name: enterAggregateType
methods.description: Called when entering a struct or aggregate type.

methods.name: exitAggregateType
methods.description: Called when exiting a struct or aggregate type.

methods.name: getBlockLayoutInfo
methods.description: Retrieves layout info for a specific type.

methods.name: advanceOffset
methods.description: Advances the current offset based on type and layout rules.
